canonical_project: LEW Green Data Center (Augsburg-Oberhausen, Krumbacher Straße)
notes: Augsburger Allgemeine (2025-01-01/02): LEW TelNet building a €30M green colocation data center ('LEW Green Data Center') at Krumbacher Straße, Augsburg-Oberhausen, 1,900 sqm / up to 600 racks, 'first green colocation RZ in the region' from early 2025; building largely finished by Jan 2025. LOCATION AMBIGUOUS: LEW/Goldbeck official material places the LEW Green Data Center in Neusäß (Landkreis Augsburg) - this Oberhausen-reported site may be the same campus or a second LEW facility; recorded separately per Augsburger Allgemeine with C grade until confirmed.
